confirm.title: NSPanel HAUI devices discovered
confirm.description: Found {count} ESPHome device(s) running HAUI firmware: {names}. Add them to a new NSPanel HAUI hub?

abort.already_configured: A hub with this name is already configured
abort.already_in_progress: A hub configuration is already in progress
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one NSPanel HAUI hub is supported
abort.no_devices_found: No NSPanel HAUI devices were detected. Install the HAUI firmware on an ESPHome device first.

reload.title: Reload hub
reload.description:
NSPanel HAUI could not start device {device}.

The error was: `{error}`.

Use the fix to retry starting the device, or check the logs for details. Reloading the NSPanel HAUI hub configuration retries starting device {device}.

hub_idle.title: NSPanel HAUI hub has no enabled devices
hub_idle.description:
The hub {hub} has no enabled devices.

Enable at least one device in the NSPanel HAUI editor, or add a new ESPHome device running the HAUI firmware. New HAUI devices can be added to the hub automatically.

open_panel.name: Open panel
open_panel.description: Navigate to a specific panel.  If wakeup is enabled the display wakes first.

device.name: Device
device.description: Target NSPanel device. If omitted, applies to all devices.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel key or UUID to navigate to (e.g. 'alarm', 'grid_0').

wakeup.name: Wake up first
wakeup.description: Wake the display before opening the panel.

close_panel.name: Close panel
close_panel.description: Close the current panel and return to the previous or home panel.

device.name: Device
device.description: Target NSPanel device. If omitted, applies to all devices.

wakeup.name: Wake up
wakeup.description: Wake the display and navigate to the wakeup or home panel.

device.name: Device
device.description: Target NSPanel device. If omitted, applies to all devices.

idle.name: Idle
idle.description: Enter the idle state immediately by opening the configured idle page (idle_panel), as if the page timeout had fired.

device.name: Device
device.description: Target NSPanel device. If omitted, applies to all devices.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Show a notification on the panel with a title, message and icon.

device.name: Device
device.description: Target NSPanel device. If omitted, applies to all devices.

title.name: Title
title.description: Notification title shown on the panel.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Material Design Icon shown with the notification (e.g. 'mdi:bell').

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds until auto-dismiss. 0 keeps it until dismissed.

persistent.name: Persistent
persistent.description: Require dismissal on the panel to stop the alert sound.

type.name: Severity
type.description: Severity level that affects the alert colour and sound.

force_show.name: Force show
force_show.description: Immediately open the notification even if another panel is displayed.

reset_last_interaction.name: Reset last interaction
reset_last_interaction.description: Reset the panel idle timer as if the user just touched it.

device.name: Device
device.description: Target NSPanel device. If omitted, applies to all devices.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Offset in seconds applied to the reset point.

update_tft.name: Update TFT
update_tft.description: Install the TFT release the panel's firmware needs, or the TFT file at a URL.

device.name: Device
device.description: NSPanel device whose display should be updated.

url.name: URL
url.description: Optional http(s) URL of a .tft file to install instead of the GitHub release the firmware needs.
